info.title: site-assistant
info.description: Stages 1–2. Same-origin cookie API; writes require exact Origin, JSON Content-Type (multipart only for knowledge/upload) and X-CSRF-Protection: 1. No CORS. Login/register: 10 attempts per peer IP per 15 minutes, 4 concurrent password operations per process. Error messages are localized by clients from error.code.
